question.text: Will Volodymyr Zelenskyy attend the Special European Council in Brussels in person on 26–27 November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves YES if Volodymyr Zelenskyy, President of Ukraine, was physically present in Brussels for the Special European Council of 26–27 November 2026 — i.e. he travelled to Brussels and took part in the summit in person on 26 or 27 November 2026 (Brussels time). Confirmation may come from official Council material (press releases, photo galleries or video published on the Council newsroom, https://newsroom.consilium.europa.eu/) or from [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions). It resolves NO if he took part in the meeting only by video link (including a pre-recorded address), did not take part at all, or if, after the meeting has ended, neither official Council material nor credible reporting shows that he was physically present in Brussels for the summit.
question.fine_print: "In person" requires physical presence at the summit in Brussels (including its doorsteps, family photo or bilateral meetings held at the summit venue); a visit to Brussels on 26–27 November 2026 for a purpose unconnected to the summit does not count. If the Special European Council is postponed beyond 27 November 2026 or converted to an all-virtual format, the question is annulled. If confirmation is not yet available when the meeting ends, resolution waits for credible reporting on the events of 26–27 November 2026.

research:
Nothing confirms or rules out an in-person Zelenskyy appearance at the 26-27 November summit yet. Nothing I found mentions him in connection with this meeting, and the official meeting page was unreadable. Some "facts" in the background could not be checked (Dublin dates, October attendance details), and I relied on the summaries the search and fetch tools gave me.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-16: The Council meeting page (consilium.europa.eu/en/meetings/european-council/2026/11/26-27/) returned HTTP 403 with a browser check, so I could not read the agenda or any guest list. The newsroom (newsroom.consilium.europa.eu) will only have arrival or doorstep material once the summit happens. There is no data series to track: this is a yes/no event. [Council](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/meetings/european-council/2026/11/26-27/)
- 2026-11-11: Costa's letter to Merz confirms the "Special European Council on 26-27 November, which has two items on the agenda": the MFF and Ukraine's 2027 financing. I found no public invitation letter for the 26-27 meeting and no mention of Zelenskyy taking part. [Eurointegration](https://www.eurointegration.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/11/7249753/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question. I found no announcement from his office, the EU or the press that he will attend in person or by video.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-15: Zelenskyy said Kyiv is preparing for the Ramstein group meeting in Brussels on 17 Nov and a Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin this week. Merz expects 20+ leaders in Berlin. RFE/RL gives no plans for him after this week. [RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-ramstein-coalition-willing-russia-zelenskyy/33899112.html)
- 2026-11-13/14: Marine Le Pen told AFP she would meet Zelenskyy "if I can meet him in Brussels." No date was given and Kyiv has not said it accepts. If a meeting happens around the summit it could be a sign he is in Brussels, but nothing links the two. [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90094)
- 2026-11-14: Zelenskyy reported on his trip to Denmark and Ireland (€645m Danish defence package). This shows he has been travelling a lot in Europe lately. [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90117)
- 2026-11-13/14: The informal Dublin leaders' meeting left the €45bn in 2027 funding and the choice of an EU Ukraine envoy undecided, pushing them to the November summit. [Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/politics/2026/11/14/eu-leaders-talk-it-out-in-dublin-but-leave-the-big-calls-for-another-day/)
- 2026-11-12: Eunews says Costa and von der Leyen will discuss Kyiv's 2027 needs and a 22nd sanctions package at the 26-27 Nov summit. It does not say whether Zelenskyy will be there. [Eunews](https://www.eunews.it/en/2026/11/12/patriot-missiles-energy-eu-membership-and-a-seat-at-the-peace-table-zelenskys-latest-appeals-to-europeans/)
- 2026-10-26: The planned four-way Brussels meeting (Ukraine, US, EU, NATO) fell apart after Trump reportedly kept Witkoff and Kushner in Washington. Zelenskyy's office had leaked that he would come anyway, and EU officials scrambled to prepare. His travel plans can be unreliable. [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/how-zelenskys-team-sent-brussels-scrambling-over-a-meeting-that-never-was/)
- 2026-10 (mid-month): He attended the October European Council in person. [UNN](https://unn.ua/en/news/zelenskyy-arrived-in-brussels-for-the-european-council-meeting-who-is-he-scheduled-to-meet-with), [Censor.net](https://censor.net/en/news/4028613/zelenskyy-in-brussels-for-european-council-meeting-and-partner-talks)
- 2026-10-05: The Kyiv Independent reported that his attendance at the 15 Oct summit depended on an EU accession step. In other words, whether he goes in person tends to depend on there being something to show for the trip. [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-could-celebrate-fresh-eu-accession-breakthrough-in-brussels-next-week-source-says/)

## 4. Base rates
These come from my own memory and the question background, not from sources fetched today.
- **Special European Councils:** 1 Feb 2024 (the Ukraine Facility deal): video. 17-18 Apr 2024: video. 6 Mar 2025: in person.
- **Regular European Councils:**
  - 2025: video in March and June; in person in October and December 2025 (per the background).
  - 2026: in person in June and October 2026 (per the background).
- In the last roughly four regular summits he has been there in person every time. Before that it was about a third of the time.
- Summits mainly about money for Ukraine have gone both ways: video in Feb 2024, in person in Dec 2025.
- He was physically in Brussels on 12 Nov for EPC-related meetings (per the background). A third Western European trip in about two weeks is possible, but the wartime situation and peace-talk scheduling (Abu Dhabi talks, US envoys travelling) could get in the way.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on Zelenskyy attending this summit. None of the markets collected by code match. The nearest are Kalshi "Putin-Zelenskyy meet before 2027" at 0.06 and "Trump, Zelenskyy, Putin meet before 2027" at 0.06, which are not relevant to this question.
- I found no expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-17: Ramstein (Ukraine Defense Contact Group) meeting in Brussels. Zelenskyy's own attendance is not confirmed.
- This week: Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin with 20+ leaders. The date is not given, and the source does not say whether he will be there in person.
- Before the summit: the Commission's proposal on about €45bn in extra 2027 funding, and talks on the Council implementing decision for the remaining €45bn of the Support Loan. If a deal looks close, a trip to Brussels becomes more likely.
- Any new round of US-Ukraine-Russia talks or envoy shuttling (Witkoff and Kushner) could clash with the summit dates.
- 25 Nov: EU-Western Balkans summit. 26 Nov: Euro Summit. 26-27 Nov: the Special European Council itself. Arrival and doorstep footage on the Council newsroom will settle the question.
- A possible Le Pen meeting in Brussels: watch for a date.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 11 days remain. The summit runs 26-27 November, and the resolution check is around 27 November. For Yes, Zelensky must physically attend the Special European Council in Brussels on 26 or 27 November. Arrival or doorstep footage, a family photo, or bilateral meetings at the Europa building would confirm it. A video address does not count.

(b) Status quo: as of 16 November there is no announcement, invitation report or schedule. The default if nothing more happened is no in-person attendance. But invitations for the October summit were reported only about a week ahead, so silence now means little.

(c) Base rate: European Council meetings from December 2024 to October 2026, roughly 7 of 10 in person, including the last 3 in a row. Special summits are mixed: video in February 2024 (Ukraine Facility) and April 2024, in person in March 2025. Summits centred on Ukraine financing have recently drawn him in person (December 2025, October 2026). A base rate of about 60-65% is reasonable.

(d) Evidence for Yes:
- Ukraine's 2027 financing, the €45bn loan instalment, a possible EU envoy and the 22nd sanctions package all moved to this summit after the Dublin meeting (13-14 November). That gives him a strong reason to lobby in person.
- He attended the last three regular summits in person (June, October 2026). In October he joined on day 2 for a joint doorstep with Costa and von der Leyen.
- Le Pen offered to meet him "in Brussels" (13-14 November), which could tie in with a visit.

Evidence for No:
- He was just in western Europe on 3-5 November (Berlin, Madrid) and 12-14 November (Dublin, Denmark). A Berlin Coalition of the Willing meeting is also this week. Another trip may seem less necessary.
- The regular December European Council follows within about three weeks and may be the preferred venue for an in-person visit.
- US-Ukraine-Russia diplomacy is intense, and the Brussels trip planned for the week of 26 October was cancelled at short notice.
- The summit is shared with the MFF, so he may be given only a video slot.

(e) No scenario: Costa offers a video slot for the Ukraine item. New peace-talk activity or heavy strikes keep Zelensky in Kyiv or send him elsewhere, and he addresses leaders by video.
Yes scenario: Costa invites him for the start of day 1 or for day 2. He flies in, does a doorstep with Costa and von der Leyen to press for the €45bn plus €45bn, and perhaps holds side meetings.

(f) I start from about 62%. I move down for the travel fatigue just after two western European trips, the proximity of the December summit, the shared MFF agenda, the history of video links at special summits and the volatility of the peace talks. I move up a little for the high stakes of the financing decision and the recent run of in-person attendance. Net, I land somewhat above even.

Probability: 53%

(a) The summit runs 26-27 November, so the outcome should be known around 27 November, about 11 days away.
